entries.title: Database baseline published
entries.summary: Initial snapshot of 751 accepted species and natural hybrids across 21 genera, compiled from the ICPS Carnivorous Plant Names Resource. Every accepted name on the 21 genus pages was captured, including natural hybrids and nested infraspecific taxa.

entries.title: Nine recent descriptions added to the watchlist
entries.summary: Recent species accepted in the primary literature but not yet present in the ICPS snapshot are shown as provisional entries. They are excluded from the 751 ICPS count and are promoted automatically when ICPS lists them.

entries.title: All 939 ICPS-registered cultivars added
entries.summary: The catalogue now covers every cultivar on the ICPS registered-cultivar list, not just Dionaea: 939 records across Byblis, Cephalotus, Darlingtonia, Dionaea, Drosera, Heliamphora, Nepenthes, Pinguicula, Sarracenia and Utricularia. Each record carries the registration date, authority, originator, registrant, publication, standard, etymology and parent formula where the register records them, plus parent care and native range. Ten cultivars have a verified cultivar-specific open-licensed photograph; the other 929 use a clearly labelled representative parent-species image. Cultivars remain excluded from wild-species counts, country totals and range maps.

entries.title: Collection and wishlist, stored on your device
entries.summary: Every species and cultivar page can now be added to a personal collection or wishlist. Both lists live in this browser's local storage only, never in the database, and can be printed or exported as JSON. The catalogue itself stays read-only: only maintainers can change names, care notes or photographs. Old favourites are migrated into the collection automatically.

entries.title: Monthly ICPS check automated
entries.summary: A scheduled GitHub Actions workflow now refreshes the ICPS species and cultivar snapshots on the first day of every month, diffs them against the catalogue, adds new names, records the result in data/icps-check.json, and rebuilds and deploys the site. The same check can be run locally with node scripts/check-icps.mjs.
